import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures, StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, Ridge
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
x = np.sort(rng.uniform(-3, 3, 40))
y = np.sin(x) + rng.normal(0, 0.3, 40)
idx = rng.permutation(40)
tr, te = idx[:20], idx[20:]                 # 20 mẫu học, 20 mẫu kiểm tra
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = x[tr].reshape(-1, 1), x[te].reshape(-1, 1), y[tr], y[te]

def fit_poly(degree, model=None):
    reg = model or LinearRegression()
    pipe = make_pipeline(PolynomialFeatures(degree), StandardScaler(), reg)
    pipe.fit(Xtr, ytr)
    return (mean_squared_error(ytr, pipe.predict(Xtr)),
            mean_squared_error(yte, pipe.predict(Xte)))

for d in [1, 3, 15]:
    tr_mse, te_mse = fit_poly(d)
    print(d, round(tr_mse, 3), round(te_mse, 3))     # bậc cao: train thấp, test CAO

import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures, StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, Ridge
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
x = np.sort(rng.uniform(-3, 3, 40))
y = np.sin(x) + rng.normal(0, 0.3, 40)
idx = rng.permutation(40)
tr, te = idx[:20], idx[20:]                 # 20 mẫu học, 20 mẫu kiểm tra
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = x[tr].reshape(-1, 1), x[te].reshape(-1, 1), y[tr], y[te]

def fit_poly(degree):
    pipe = make_pipeline(PolynomialFeatures(degree), StandardScaler(), LinearRegression())
    pipe.fit(Xtr, ytr)
    return (mean_squared_error(ytr, pipe.predict(Xtr)),
            mean_squared_error(yte, pipe.predict(Xte)))

train_mse_15, test_mse_15 = fit_poly(15)
_, test_mse_3 = fit_poly(3)
print(round(train_mse_15, 3), round(test_mse_15, 3), round(test_mse_3, 3))

import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures, StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, Ridge
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
x = np.sort(rng.uniform(-3, 3, 40))
y = np.sin(x) + rng.normal(0, 0.3, 40)
idx = rng.permutation(40)
tr, te = idx[:20], idx[20:]                 # 20 mẫu học, 20 mẫu kiểm tra
Xtr, Xte, ytr, yte = x[tr].reshape(-1, 1), x[te].reshape(-1, 1), y[tr], y[te]

def test_mse(reg):
    pipe = make_pipeline(PolynomialFeatures(15), StandardScaler(), reg).fit(Xtr, ytr)
    return mean_squared_error(yte, pipe.predict(Xte))

mse_plain = test_mse(LinearRegression())
mse_ridge = test_mse(Ridge(alpha=10))
print(round(mse_plain, 3), round(mse_ridge, 3))

label.vi: Ridge cho test MSE nhỏ hơn
label.en: Ridge gives a lower test MSE
